pages: Deep in the wilds of Hida stands the Kokain temple.
And in one corner of Kokain, yet another tiny little demon grave was made.
A memorial service for demons... A strange notion indeed.
Is it the slain demons who wish to be mourned?
...Or those who slew them...?
Nicotine only smiled, and gave no answer.
Here in the Himalayas... 8848 meters above sea level...
I'm home!
Hey, Jiro! Welcome back. You must be tired.
Want a bath?
Or would you rather eat first?
Thanks, Saburo...
Let's see... I'll take a bath!
I'll get it ready right away...
Still, since we don't have to be the judges this time...
it's pretty easy work, I guess...
Yeah... Though it's a bit of a letdown...
Ichiro was pretty disappointed, too.
He said there's no 'thrill of soaking your soul in a life-or-death duel'
or something like that.
True... This time we're just the record keepers.
I'm hooome!
Oh, Jiro...
Welcome back, Shiro!
Saburo's getting the bath ready for us now.
Want to join me?
Really? Great... I'm kind of worn out today...
Oh my, that's no good. What happened?
They've got me keeping records on Cham Cham,
and it's sooo exhausting!
She blabs on and on about every little thing,
so it gets longer and longer. It's a pain to remember it all!
Still, the ones who don't talk are a pain in their own way.
...Ichiro got stuck with Genjuro, after all.
Genjuro, huh...
I hate to say it, but...
I just can't bring myself to like that guy...
Something about his eyes... they're kind of, you know...
He's the one who told us to 'Record this!' himself,
and then he won't say a single word!
It really gets on my nerves!
Right! And if you dare ask him anything,
he yells 'Fool!' at you. He's impossible to deal with!
But...
But?
According to Ichiro, 'That's what's... good about him.'
Ichiro really is a grown-up, isn't he?
Yeah... a real grown-up.
Anyway, as for Haohmaru...
he's quite something in his own way, too...
Ah, that guy...
You've got to take half of what he says with a grain of salt...
If it were all like Haohmaru says,
nothing but 'insanely strong swordsmen' and 'monstrous demons',
nobody would ever be able to clear this RPG!
Sniff, sniff... Come to think of it, brother...
Yeah...
The folks watching on TV wouldn't know this, but...
that man really smells, too.
And if you hang around him, the smell rubs off on you.
Everyone in the party keeps their distance from him a bit.
Especially the young ladies and Ukyo.
Heh heh heh...
What about Charlotte?
Brother, your bath is ready...
Oh, Shiro, you're back?
I'm home, Saburo.
Saburo, you were assigned to Nakoruru, right?
Lucky you, Saburo.
Hehehe... Speaking of Nakoruru,
guess what I heard?
Huh? What? What is it, brother?
That Nakoruru, you know... she's so... well...
So what? Come on, spit it out...
When I was taking her record, she said to me... get this...
'Um... This is a secret, right? You won't tell anyone...
You'll keep it quiet, right?'
And her pale little cheeks turned bright red...
Oh, come on!
Really? No fair, brother...
Yeah... come on... Tell us...
No, no, not this... It's one of the perks of the job...
What's that supposed to mean? Quit teasing and tell us!
That's right!
We won't tell anyone else... promise!
Okay then, just the juicy part...
Mumble mumble...
And then...
Whaaat?! That's so daring!
I can't believe it... We're talking about Nakoruru!
That's not all, either! On top of that...
And what's more... even though...
...even... ...and... ...finally!!
Yep, yep. Totally shocking.
A girl like her... ...huh...
I guess Nakoruru's a woman after all...
isn't she...
That's kind of a shock...
Now, now, Shiro... That's just how it is.
Shiro's been a secret fan of Nakoruru, after all.
Hey! Saburo!
Oh... Ichiro...
Don't 'Ichiro' me! Honestly!!
Jiro and Shiro, too...
When we accepted this job,
I told you never to speak a word of what we record!
Especially you, Jiro! I'm very disappointed in you!
As the elder brother, you should be keeping them in line...
I... I'm terribly sorry, brother...
Sigh... You still lack the awareness of a true kuroko.
...What troublesome brothers I have...
I'm hooome!
Ah, Goro... Good work...
Goro was on Ukyo duty, right? Better disinfect right away.
Oh yeah, about that... It's Ukyo, see...
I heard it today. Get this, Ukyo actually...
H-hey... Goro!
Keeping the client's secrets is what
being a professional is all about, isn't it?
R-right, right...
Aww... But...
What?! Ukyo did what?
Behind the samurai's every triumph, there are the kuroko...
Now and then, why not spare a thought
for the unsung heroes of Samurai Shodown...
Hahahaha!
Your son is already part of my body!
One as unskilled as you would only be a burden...
Stay with your mother and await good news...
Dear...
I do not ask you to understand...
Anyone who objects may strike me down as a rogue ninja.
Have no fear...
Slaying Amakusa is all but a Shogunate order. It is no private feud.
We are all of one mind... Trust in our judgment and leave the rest to us.
...Forgive me.
Thanks to the samurai's efforts,
and to Hanzo, who supported them from the shadows,
the fiend Amakusa Shiro perished along with his castle in the sky.
Hanzo succeeded in reclaiming the body of Amakusa...
no, of his son Shinzo.
However...
No... Brother!
Ohh...
N-no... it can't be... Dear...!
It is hopeless...
Shinzo's soul has already been devoured by the demon realm...
Th-then my brother is...!
A living corpse...
N-no! Brother!
But Shinzo, I will not let you go alone...
I shall follow you soon.
Kanzo, take care of Kaede...
Become a fine ninja!
Father... Please, reconsider!
Wait! Master Hanzo!
Master Hanzo! Don't be rash!
Please, please hear us out!
Hmm... You...
Master Hanzo, we understand the grief in your heart...
But think of those you would leave behind,
of us, and of Lady Kaede and young Kanzo!
Without you, what will become of the Shogunate?
There is no guarantee that a second or third Amakusa
will not appear!
...Even so...
Secret art of the Iga ninja! Soul Resonance Revival!
M-Mother!
Kaede! What are you doing?!
That's a forbidden art that recalls a soul at the cost of one's own life...
Im-impossible... Lady Kaede, you mean to give your life?!
Kaede...
F-Father...
Father! Brother... Brother has regained consciousness!
...He is safe... Your art... has succeeded.
M-Mother... Motherrr!
Brother... I'm so glad you're safe...
Very well... This life of mine has died once already...
I entrust it to you all...
Ah... Kanzo, is it?
I've finally reached the age to begin the same training as you, brother...
I humbly ask for your guidance!
I see... Father's training is harsh.
Without true resolve, you won't even be able to keep up.
What about you, brother? How is your health?
I intend to train myself anew from here on...
This affair taught me just how unskilled I am...
The way of the ninja
is harder than either of you can imagine...
Overcome your mother's death, and surpass your father's arts!
...Know that this will be the finest tribute to your late mother Kaede...
Yes! Father!
I understand...
I may lack talent, but with all my heart and soul...
Good... Now go!
Through the samurai's efforts, Amakusa Shiro was destroyed.
Shiranui Gen-an, self-proclaimed king of the demon realm, joyfully
made a triumphant return to his home, Oninaki Island.
Fallen, fallen, fallen! Nkekeke...
Amakusa fell into darkness, too,
so now I'm the true Demon King in name and deed, kee!
Dear... is it really you...?
You've come home!
Oh, Azami!
Rejoice, I am the Demon King!
Congratulations... You've finally mastered the dark arts.
Now, I must make a feast tonight...
A dark hot pot of monkfish and demon centipede, extra sinister!
Zakuro and Mukuro have grown so big, too... hehe.
...What's wrong, dear...?
Azami, I cannot come home...
No, I WON'T come home, kee.
?! B-but why...
I have not yet fully mastered the dark arts.
The prey of worlds yet unseen are calling to me,
begging me to drag them down.
As king of darkness, I must sip my victims' blood,
rip out their spines and feast on corpse flesh
forever, kee!
B-but, dear...
You've only just come home...
...No, never mind me.
At least... at least see your children's faces...
Don't follow me, kee!
...The dark path has no need for women!
Forgive me, kee...
Deceit... Betrayal... Threats... Provocation...
Shiranui Gen-an, self-proclaimed king of darkness,
tore the world's poor victims apart with his sharp claws.
Time passed, and once again... Oninaki Island.
...Keke. I've done every dark deed there is,
but none of them were worth dragging down, kee...
I've finally found you, Shiranui Gen-an!
...And who are you?
I've come to take your life.
...Fight me!
Nkekeke!
The more I look at you, the nastier you seem, kee!
But I won't go easy on you just because you're a woman.
Stop your yapping and come at me!
Or are you scared of me?
Nkeee! I'll kill youuu!
Here I come!
Nkekekeee!
Hah!
N-no waaay!
You let your guard down, Shiranui Gen-an!
Your arrogance as the 'king of darkness' was your downfall.
A-A-Azamiii!!
Ohohohoho!
Bravo! Best in Japan!
My marrow is whispering strangely today...
Ah! That's...
I knew it! Lord Gen-an's weapon! Oh... how could this happen...
I always feared that someday, something like this would happen...
Dear...
Oh... there's something carved here...
Azami?
Oh... Lord Gen-an... You carved my name on your weapon...
Oh... Lord Gen-an...
Gen-an... Shiranui Gen-an...
Wh-who's there, kee?
Do you crave blood...? Do you long to rend flesh...?
Who are you, kee?
My name is... ruler of darkness... A...b...r...a...
...? (Couldn't quite hear that, kee.)
I shall revive you in the mortal world...
